scope: Only explicitly requested missing-license package families. Packages are pinned by root Cargo.lock, except worker packages with a separate lockfile_evidence record. This collection does not select dependencies for any build target or assert complete distribution compliance.
verification: Cached .crate SHA-256 values match the applicable lockfile. Cached Cargo.toml, Cargo.toml.orig and .cargo_vcs_info.json match the archives. Original package manifests match the reported revision Git blobs, allowing only the recorded CRLF difference. Upstream license files match their Git blob hashes. Official linked license terms and source notice excerpts are identified separately, with any text extraction recorded.
